response.overview: A young girl struggles through her day to day life, the weight of her environment and disassociation isolating her from the world she once experienced, keeping her in an separate world to the one she once truly lived in and experienced. When she discovers an old friendship bracelet tucked away in a box of childhood memories, something is triggered inside her, challenging her to break her depressive loop that had weighed her down for too long. In attempt to reconnect with her life, environment and inner child, the girl embarks on a quiet journey to experience her ideal day.
response.title: Over the Hill
